statement.summary: Lemma 3.2 is frozen as three Props: `orderLcmStatement` (|⟨v⟩| = lcm_i n/gcd(l_i,n)), `orderGcdStatement` (|⟨v⟩| = n/gcd(l_1,…,l_d,n)) and `orderCountStatement` (the two counts of |S_{n^d}(v)|, plus the Lagrange divisibility |⟨v⟩| ∣ n^d as an explicit conjunct). The paper's chains a = b = c are rendered as a = b and a = c (common left side). The coordinates l_i are integer lifts of the residues v_i, quantified over every lift. `orderLemmaStatement` is the conjunction.
deltas: The coordinates l_i ∈ ℤ/nℤ are read as integers: every statement quantifies over EVERY integer lift `l : Fin d → ℤ` with `(l i : ZMod n) = v i` (gcd(l_i, n) depends only on l_i mod n).
gcd(l_i, n) = `Int.gcd (l i) n`; gcd(l_1,…,l_d,n) = `gcdAll l n` = `Nat.gcd (gcd_i |l_i|) n`; lcm_i = `Finset.univ.lcm` over `Fin d`.
All divisions (n/gcd, n^d/|⟨v⟩|) are ℕ-divisions; each is exact (gcd ∣ n; |⟨v⟩| ∣ n^d is an explicit extra conjunct). n^{d-1} uses truncated subtraction, exact since d ≥ 1.
The chains a = b = c are split as a = b ∧ a = c; for the count this is an equality of values, not of exponents (for σ = 1 the exponents are not determined).
Standing hypotheses n ≥ 2, d ≥ 1 (Definition 2.1); the count allows σ ≥ 1 (counting statement); alphabet Σ = `Fin σ`.
S_{n^d}(v) = `{s : Config n d (Fin σ) | shift v s = s}` (Definition 2.3's first form, not Fix(⟨v⟩)).

maps.label: 0 ≠ v ∈ 𝒜
maps.note: 𝒜 = (ℤ/nℤ)^d is `Lat n d := Fin d → ZMod n`. (The hypothesis v ≠ 0 is not used by the proofs: all three identities also hold at v = 0; keeping it is faithful.)

maps.label: v = (l_1,…,l_d): integer coordinates

lean.text: ∀ l : Fin d → ℤ, (∀ i, ((l i : ℤ) : ZMod n) = v i) →
∀ l : Fin d → ℤ, (∀ i, ((l i : ℤ) : ZMod n) = v i) →
∀ l : Fin d → ℤ, (∀ i, ((l i : ℤ) : ZMod n) = v i) →

maps.note: The paper applies gcd to the coordinates of v; Lean quantifies over every integer lift l of v (the canonical lift (v i).val is one instance), so the statement is lift-independent and as strong as possible.

maps.label: standing hypotheses n ≥ 2, d ≥ 1
maps.note: From Definition 2.1; the two order identities do not involve σ, so no alphabet hypothesis appears.

maps.label: count: n ≥ 2, d ≥ 1, σ ≥ 1
maps.note: The count is a counting statement, so Definition 2.1 allows σ = 1.

maps.label: alphabet Σ with |Σ| = σ
maps.note: Σ = `Fin σ`; only |Σ| = σ enters the paper.

maps.label: |⟨v⟩| = lcm_i(n/gcd(l_i,n))

lean.text:
Nat.card (AddSubgroup.zmultiples v)
        = Finset.univ.lcm (fun i => n / Int.gcd (l i) (n : ℤ))

maps.note: First equality of the paper's chain; equality of natural numbers.

maps.label: |⟨v⟩| (order of the cyclic subgroup)
maps.note: ⟨v⟩ is mathlib's `AddSubgroup.zmultiples v` (the subgroup {k•v : k ∈ ℤ}); |·| = `Nat.card`.

maps.label: ⟨v⟩
maps.note: The cyclic subgroup generated by v.

maps.label: lcm_i(n/gcd(l_i,n))

lean.text: Finset.univ.lcm (fun i => n / Int.gcd (l i) (n : ℤ))

maps.note: lcm over i ∈ Fin d as `Finset.univ.lcm` (nonempty since d ≥ 1).

maps.label: n/gcd(l_i,n)
maps.note: `Int.gcd` of the integer lift and n (a natural number); ℕ-division, exact since gcd(l_i,n) ∣ n.

maps.label: |⟨v⟩| = n/gcd(l_1,…,l_d,n)

lean.text: Nat.card (AddSubgroup.zmultiples v) = n / gcdAll l n

maps.note: The paper's second equality is lcm = n/gcd; Lean states |⟨v⟩| = n/gcd (same left side as the first equality). Together with `orderLcmStatement` this is equivalent to the paper's chain.

maps.label: n/gcd(l_1,…,l_d,n)
maps.note: ℕ-division, exact because gcdAll l n is a `Nat.gcd _ n`, hence divides n.

maps.label: gcd(l_1,…,l_d,n)
maps.note: gcd of the absolute values |l_i| and n: gcd over i ∈ Fin d, then with n.

maps.label: |S_{n^d}(v)| = σ^{n^d/|⟨v⟩|}

lean.text:
Nat.card {s : Config n d (Fin σ) | shift v s = s}
          = σ ^ (n ^ d / Nat.card (AddSubgroup.zmultiples v))

maps.note: First equality of the count chain; equality of natural numbers.

maps.label: |S_{n^d}(v)|

lean.text: Nat.card {s : Config n d (Fin σ) | shift v s = s}

maps.note: S_{n^d}(v) = {s : τ_v s = s} (Definition 2.3), with τ_v = `shift v`, (shift v s)(u) = s(u+v) as in Definition 2.2; |·| = `Nat.card`.

maps.label: exponent n^d/|⟨v⟩|
maps.note: ℕ-division; exactness is the separate conjunct `|⟨v⟩| ∣ n^d`.

maps.label: |⟨v⟩| divides n^d (Lagrange)
maps.note: Implicit in the paper (the exponent must be an integer); made explicit so the ℕ-division cannot truncate.

maps.label: |S_{n^d}(v)| = σ^{n^{d-1} gcd(l_1,…,l_d,n)}

lean.text:
Nat.card {s : Config n d (Fin σ) | shift v s = s}
          = σ ^ (n ^ (d - 1) * gcdAll l n)

maps.note: The paper's second equality σ^{n^d/|⟨v⟩|} = σ^{n^{d-1}gcd} is rendered with the common left side |S_{n^d}(v)| (values, not exponents).

maps.label: exponent n^{d-1}·gcd(l_1,…,l_d,n)
maps.note: Juxtaposition = ℕ-multiplication; gcd(l_1,…,l_d,n) = `gcdAll l n` as above.

maps.label: n^{d-1}
maps.note: Truncated ℕ-subtraction d − 1, exact because d ≥ 1.
